description.p: Hello Contest is a log for HF contests. It shows the QSOs, the score and the spots of the contest, and it controls the transceiver.

ul.li: Logging with duplicate check, exchange prediction and enter-sends-message
Score and rate for many contests, with the rules of the conval library
Spots from the DX cluster, from the RBN and from SDRainer, in a bandmap
Transceiver control through hamlib and TCI, with two VFOs
CW keyer with macros, and a parrot for voice contests
Export to Cabrillo, ADIF and CSV
